title: Chapter 1383
text:
The three Universal Civilizations would not deliberately publicize the failure of the interception circle, but paper could not hide fire. As the troops of the various large organizations retreated to the explored universe, this bad news quickly spread to the galactic society that was constantly paying attention to the battle situation, causing widespread panic.

In the past year or so, the refugees who had migrated to the Central Galaxy from all over the world had gotten used to the news of the interception circle successfully blocking the World Tree time and time again. This made many people feel that forced refuge was worth it, and they had already treated the interception circle as a 'border' to stop the enemy.

As long as the interception circle was there, they would have a sense of security. They thought that this barrier would be able to stop the World Tree and prevent the flames of war from spreading to their territory.

However, now that this barrier had been broken by the enemy, the confidence in the hearts of the people had been sucked away. The chain reaction was shocking. Not only did it cause panic and fear, but it also caused the trust of the three Universal Civilizations to plummet.

In the eyes of the galactic residents, the three Universal Civilizations were almost omnipotent 'kings'. However, even with such powerful rulers working together, they still failed once against the enemy. Although there were many factors involved, in the eyes of ordinary people, this was like a mathematical equation of 3 < 1. It symbolized that the three Universal Civilizations were no match for the enemy!

Many people were willing to accept the forced migration because they believed that the three Universal Civilizations would be able to defeat the enemy in the end. However, if the three Universal Civilizations could not defeat the invaders, was it really safe for them to stay in the Central Galaxy to seek refuge? Would they be waiting for death?

This thought spread like a virus in the hearts of the galactic residents, nourishing uneasiness, panic, fear, and other emotions. Even though the public opinion control department of the three Universal Civilizations was constantly working, the overflowing emotions were like a flood that broke through a dam. It was not so easy to stop them.

Then, chaos broke out.

A large number of refugee planets had frequent cases of people seizing ships and escaping. Some of them were no longer willing to believe in the three Universal Civilizations and felt that staying behind would be equivalent to waiting for death. They tried to 'save themselves' before the enemy attacked and escaped from the explored universe.

The refugees who were originally docile and under the control of the three Universal Civilizations erupted with a sense of group resistance in front of their lives. The difficulty of management suddenly increased, and the three Universal Civilizations had no choice but to spend more energy comforting and suppressing the refugees.

All of a sudden, chaos broke out.

In his previous life, the enemies were ferocious, and the people had no choice but to retreat. Now that the three Universal Civilizations had time to prepare for war, they also gave the people a choice. There were pros and cons. At the very least, it was impossible to easily reach the state of everyone being a soldier like in his previous life.

…

Beyond Grade A Association headquarters, Planet Finn.

Due to the large-scale deployment of the three Universal Civilizations' armies, many Beyond Grade A organizations had changed the location of the association's headquarters. This planet in the middle of the Flickering World had been moved to Black Star's territory.

Ever since a large number of Beyond Grade As had rushed to the frontlines, the Beyond Grade A Association had entered a state of suspension. At this moment, Han Xiao and the other participants had returned to the association, and a full meeting was held after a year or so.

In the Round Table Conference Room, many Association members were gathered. Compared to the packed seats before the battle, there were now many empty seats. Every empty seat represented a sacrifice.

"… That's the details. In at least eleven years, the World Tree will invade the mainland and reach the border of the Flickering World …"

Han Xiao's tone was low as he relayed the results of the battle meeting between the three Universal Civilizations.

Hearing this information, all the Beyond Grade As present had solemn expressions. Their hearts were heavy, and the atmosphere was solemn.

"Eleven years is too short …"

A Beyond Grade A Super could not help but ask with a worried tone.

This amount of time was fleeting in the eyes of the Beyond Grade As. Even in the time scale of an ordinary person, it was less than a generation.

The World Tree's shocking attack that broke through the intercepting circle left a deep impression on the participants. When they thought about how the endless Green Tide would invade their territory soon, like a disaster that devoured everything, covering the entire explored universe bit by bit, everyone subconsciously tensed up and became extremely fearful.

Kasuyi knocked on the table and encouraged, "On the bright side, we still have at least eleven years to prepare. In this year of fighting with the World Tree, we have also discovered many of our shortcomings. We can use this opportunity to perfect them."

Because he knew the truth about the Sanctums and Iterations, he had always been a firm supporter of the war. He was the other pillar of support other than Han Xiao.

But after he finished speaking, most of the participants didn't respond as usual. Instead, they remained silent. Meanwhile, the members of the Avoidance Association who were divided to begin with naturally didn't show any signs of approval.

Dylan placed his elbows on the table and took in everyone's expressions. He sneered mockingly.

"Tsk, I've long said that your attitude will change after you experience the war. Now you know that I'm right, right? Look at you guys. You were so passionate when you set off, but now? In the end, he was beaten back by the enemy with a face full of dust and grime! So many association members sacrificed their lives, but in the end, they still couldn't stop the enemy from advancing. Tell me, what's the use of sacrificing these people? It's just a waste of the only chance to revive. "

Hearing this, most of the participants clenched their fists or claws. They were clearly angered, but no one retorted.

In fact, Dillon's words struck a chord in their hearts. In the galactic battlefield, many people felt their own insignificance. Seeing the Beyond Grade As who usually called the shots in the galactic society die one after another, the others' conviction to participate in the battle became more and more shaken.

Seeing this, Han Xiao frowned and said with a deep voice, "Enough, shut up.

"Alright, shut up. At least we cooperated with the three Universal Civilizations and delayed the World Tree's invasion by a year."

"Heh, just a year …"

Dylan curled his lips and did not think much of it, but he did not dare to continue speaking under Han Xiao's gaze.

Han Xiao no longer looked at him. His gaze swept across everyone as he slowly said, "No matter what, these eleven years are the final preparation period. We can't waste them. I will unconditionally borrow the Evolution Cube and a series of Universal Treasures to increase everyone's strength. The other people who have similar Universal Treasures should do the same. Everyone has been in the position of 'galactic bigshot' for too long. Some people have not been able to improve for a long time and have already neglected their training. I suggest that everyone start special training and become stronger."

"How do we train? Who will train? "Kohler was curious.

Han Xiao pondered.

"The peak Beyond Grade As of the various systems will be the instructors, imparting their experience and guiding the route. As the chief instructor, I will be in charge of all the special training plans. On one hand, I have to increase my personal strength, and on the other hand, I have to practice the cooperation of working together against the enemy.

Furthermore, everyone will be training in actual combat, so there's no need to worry about getting injured. Aurora will be in charge of healing. During peacetime, as the representatives of individual strength, we don't have the chance to fight frequently. Now is not the time to worry about face and prestige. We have to increase our combat strength as much as possible. Actual combat is the best way. Winning or losing is not important. Perfecting our own abilities is the most important. "

He did want to increase the average combat strength of the Beyond Grade As, but on the other hand, he also felt that this was a good excuse to find people to spar frequently. He might be able to get more abilities.

Hearing this, everyone hesitated for a moment but did not object.

At this moment, Secret Master said with a deep voice.

"What if the three Universal Civilizations lose in the end?"

Han Xiao lowered his eyes and slowly said, "I promise you, I promise.

If things don't work out, I won't ask for anything else. I will definitely bring everyone out of the explored universe and into the endless sea of stars. Therefore, these eleven years will also be the time for us to transfer the resources of our Beyond Grade A organizations and prepare a backup plan. "

Han Xiao did not think that the three Universal Civilizations would definitely be able to defeat the World Tree. Now that the timeline was different, whether or not they could find the main body of the World Tree was a complete mystery. The chances were unknown. If they could not find it, the three Universal Civilizations would have almost no chance of winning. He had also prepared for the worst and was prepared to arrange a backup plan for the association in advance.

If the three Universal Civilizations were really dead, he would abandon this place without mercy. The universe was huge, and there was nowhere he could not go.

The regular meeting lasted for a while before everyone dispersed with their own thoughts.

When everyone had left, Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief, took out his communicator, and contacted Oathkeeper to ask about the progress of the Sanctum's key collection. His priority was naturally the First Sanctum, and the flow of time was the most similar.

However, Oathkeeper's answer was that he had not gathered the materials yet and needed to wait for some time.

"I hope we can start the second round of revival as soon as possible. The fighting spirit of the association members has been shaken."

Han Xiao thought to himself.

Many revivors felt that they had used up their only chance of revival and would no longer need him in the future, so they were disobedient. Now, he urgently needed to use the truth to correct these people's thoughts. Only by showing that he was indispensable would he have the right to speak infinitely and make the Beyond Grade As rely on him more.

At the same time, the two sisters walked out of the venue one after another.

Suddenly, Hella stopped in her tracks. Aurora, who had her head lowered, bumped into her back as if she did not notice. Only then did she come back to her senses and look up blankly.

"What's wrong with you recently? Ever since the thought seal was removed, your condition hasn't been right. You're often in a daze. It was the same during the meeting just now. "

Hella turned around and sized up Aurora with a frown.

"I …" Aurora clenched her small fists and lowered her head. She hesitated and said, "I'm just thinking, if I were much stronger than now, would these things still happen?"

"Oh?" Hella raised her brows and did not answer.

Aurora pursed her lips and muttered to herself,

"Black Star said that my current level is far from being able to unleash the true level of this Esper Ability. If I become stronger, I'll be able to summon more Underworld Heroes at any time. If I become stronger, I'll be able to resist the thought seal this time. If I become stronger, I won't have so many companions dying in battle …"

As she spoke, her voice became more and more disappointed and filled with self-blame.

"All of this is because I'm not strong enough!"

Hella looked at her quietly and waited for her to vent her emotions before speaking expressionlessly.

"Yes, it's because you're not strong enough! They're all comforting you, saying that it's not your fault, but in my eyes, it's your problem. If you were a peak Beyond Grade A, the losses in this battle could have been avoided! "

Hearing this, Aurora twisted her fingers and felt even more ashamed.

After becoming a Beyond Grade A a few years ago, she no longer needed to be controlled by Black Star and Hella, and her heart had become wild. She felt that she was finally free.

Her Esper Ability could ensure her survival, and she had inherited the powerful Underworld Hero Spirit. She had also obtained the support of a large number of association members, and she even had life-saving equipment given by Black Star. She had all kinds of trump cards, so she had relaxed and stopped training.

It was only after this setback that Aurora regretted not training hard in the past few years.

Aurora looked straight into Hella's eyes, bit her lower lip, and made up her mind.

"Sister, can you help me with the special training?"

The corners of Hila's mouth curled up into an almost imperceptible smile. Then, she put on a straight face and said lightly,

She then put on a straight face and said, "Then be prepared. I won't go easy on you."

…

In the secondary dimension world.

This was a space filled with black liquid matter, like a deep sea where one could not see their own fingers.

A fleet was slowly advancing like a group of submarines.

This was one of the first teams sent out by the three Universal Civilizations. After a year of trekking, they had long entered the depths of the secondary dimensions, far away from the shallow layer controlled by the three Universal Civilizations.

At this moment, in a simple single room in the living quarters of one of the battleships, Harrison was anxiously pacing back and forth, muttering, "In the main world, the three Universal Civilizations have already broken through the blockade of the three Universal Civilizations.

"In the main universe, the World Tree has already broken through the three Universal Civilizations' intercepting circle. If we don't speed up our progress here, the enemy will be able to invade our territory soon … How can we find the thing Your Excellency Black Star is talking about?"

Due to the poor communication in the secondary dimension, the expedition team could not maintain a stable communication with their hometown and could only report the situation occasionally. During the last exchange of information, the expedition team that Harrison was in had learned that the interceptor circle had been broken, which made him anxious.

After more than a year of searching, the expedition team had not found anything. They had not even seen any traces of the World Tree troops.

The secondary dimensions were endless, and new dimensions were born and old dimensions were destroyed every moment. The relationship between the secondary dimensions was unpredictable and constantly changing. If there were no specific coordinates, the difficulty of finding something was far greater than in the main universe.

"The chances of trying my luck like this are too low. When will I find any clues …"

Harrison clenched his fists. The thought of his hometown being threatened by the invaders made him unable to calm down.

Harrison, who was immersed in his emotions, did not notice that in the dark sea outside the porthole, a huge shadow swam past. It was almost impossible to distinguish in the darkness. The strange thing was that even the fleet's multifunctional radar did not notice it.
